**Checklist before upload**
* Use the conference's own template if it differs from `IEEEtran` (swap the preamble only; the body is unchanged).
* Page limit (usually 6 + references), double-blind rules (remove author names and the GitHub/Zenodo links if the review is anonymous), copyright form, registration fee and presenter requirement.
* PDF eXpress / IEEE Xplore compliance check if the conference uses it.
* Do not submit this paper and the journal paper at the same time.
